title: Voice Share — payload
description: One committed voice note, sealed to the keeper's public key. The response ($defs.Response) is the appended link.

voice.description: The note's id, as committed with mages/voice/commit.

audioHash.description: sha256 of the open audio, so the keeper can check the copy is the note.

iv.description: The keeper copy's AES-GCM initialisation vector, base64.

wrapped.description: The AES key wrapped to the keeper's RSA-OAEP public key, base64.

seq.description: The link's sequence number on the guide's chain.

hash.description: The link's hash, folding the previous link's hash.
